A Revolution Born from Necessity


Born out of a need for more effective security solutions, Interlock was conceived as a response to the failure of traditional providers to combat persistent phishing and social engineering attacks.

Despite billions of dollars spent on security, existing Web2 solutions remained disjointed and ineffective. Recognizing the need for a new collaborative approach, we began our journey to create Interlock - a beacon of improved cybersecurity in a digital and crypto-focused world.

Watch Explainer Video

Combating Security Challenges in the Crypto World.

Mass theft and inadequate security solutions threaten crypto mass adoption, with $16 billion stolen from end-users in the last two years. Traditional security providers remain siloed and ineffective, despite $97.4 billion spent globally on security software in 2021.
